purpose: Route substantive materials, spectroscopy, detector, battery, memristor, and security information surfaced while scanning the 22345/32542/53242 target family, while preserving their observed occurrences as metadata/incidental controls rather than physical Glob evidence.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, indexing records, author copies, repository copies, and repeated publisher records are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: A DOI suffix, article page, postal code, CVE number, repository identifier, catalog number, or search co-occurrence is not Glob evidence unless a predeclared physical quantity and unit relationship is independently established.

sources.title: Reaction Mechanism of the Sn2Fe Anode in Lithium-Ion Batteries
sources.authors: Zhixin Dong et al.; M. Stanley Whittingham
sources.note: Use the combined synchrotron XRD, XAS and magnetic characterization over repeated lithiation/delithiation cycles as a multimodal reaction-mechanism and degradation-validation precedent for Worldshepherd energy/material systems. Exact 22345 is the first page of the article, not a physical target.

sources.title: Photoinduced multistage phase transitions in Ta2NiSe5
sources.note: Use the combined ultrashort photoexcitation, transport, coherent-phonon spectroscopy and TEM workflow as a programmable/material-state-transition validation precedent. The reported strong-pump state shows a resistivity drop of more than four orders at 50 K and is stable to at least 350 K. Exact 22345 occurs only in the DOI suffix.

sources.title: 1H MRS of intramyocellular lipids in soleus muscle at 7 T: spectral simplification by using long echo times without water suppression
sources.authors: Jimin Ren; A. Dean Sherry; Craig R. Malloy
sources.authority: Magnetic Resonance in Medicine / PubMed-indexed research
sources.note: Use only as a signal-separation methodology reference and clean DOI-suffix control: long-echo acquisition reduces spectral overlap and allows rapid high-resolution MR spectra without water suppression. The number 22345 is metadata only.

sources.title: Synthesis and characterization of novel Al(III)-metallopolymer and its application as a non-volatile resistive memristive material
sources.identifier: doi:10.1002/app.53242; J. Appl. Polym. Sci. e53242
sources.authority: Journal of Applied Polymer Science / Wiley
sources.note: Use as a low-voltage nonvolatile metallopolymer/memristive materials reference, including structure-property and electrochemical characterization. Exact 53242 is an article/DOI identifier, not a physical measurement.

sources.title: CVE-2026-53242 — Linux ALSA PCM wait-queue list corruption in snd_pcm_drain() linked streams
sources.authority: NIST National Vulnerability Database / kernel.org CNA
sources.note: Use as an OS/audio-stack hardening input for Worldshepherd Linux deployments and as a clean M1 target collision. The resolved bug concerns linked-stream wait-queue corruption in snd_pcm_drain(); the target digits come from the CVE identifier only.

sources.title: Detection of Residual Stress in Silicon Carbide MEMS by micro-Raman Spectroscopy
sources.authors: John C. Zingarelli; Michael A. Marciniak; Jason R. Foley
sources.note: Use as a spatial stress-mapping benchmark: micro-Raman scans of 6H-SiC MEMS identify TO Stokes peak shifts up to about 2 cm^-1 and calibrate phonon deformation potential against applied stress. The AFRL 32542 postal code is location metadata only.

sources.title: Quantitative Absorption Spectroscopy of Aluminum Atoms in Cryogenic Parahydrogen Solids
sources.author: Mario E. Fajardo
sources.authority: The Journal of Physical Chemistry A / U.S. Air Force Research Laboratory
sources.note: Use as a quantitative spectroscopy/deposition-control benchmark: UV/IR absorption is used to determine Al concentration, pH2 thickness, flux and isolation efficiency while distinguishing reaction products and matrix shifts. The AFRL 32542 postal code is an affiliation control only.

sources.title: Impact of Al2O3 and HfO2 Gate Dielectrics on Photoresponse of Graphene Channel Field-Effect MWIR Photodetectors with HgCdTe Absorber
sources.authority: Journal of Electronic Materials / Springer Nature
sources.note: Use as an MWIR detector architecture/prototype benchmark: room-temperature graphene/HgCdTe arrays, HfO2 versus Al2O3 dielectric comparison, 4-um response, dielectric-dependent photoresponse and detectivity. The AFRL 32542 affiliation is location metadata only.

sources.title: Matrix isolation spectroscopy and spectral simulations of isotopically substituted C60 molecules
sources.authors: Tomonari Wakabayashi; Takamasa Momose; Mario E. Fajardo
sources.note: Use as an isotopic/matrix-perturbation spectroscopy benchmark: high-resolution IR compares C60 isotopic composition and multiple cryogenic hosts to separate intrinsic isotopic shifts from environmental trapping effects. The AFRL 32542 postal code is location metadata only.
